title: About 25 broken relative links in docs/guides/heron-implementation.md and layout-aware-ocr-results.md
description:
**Problem**
Relative links in the two guides point to files that do not exist, so they break in the built site and on GitHub.

**Evidence**
- About 25 bad relative links across docs/guides/heron-implementation.md and docs/guides/layout-aware-ocr-results.md (found by a link check over the docs tree).

**Fix**
Fix or remove each link (best done together with the rewrite of those guides in the "task completion reports" issue). Add a link check to the docs build.

**How to verify**
A link checker (or `sphinx-build -b linkcheck docs docs/_build/linkcheck`) reports zero broken internal links for those two files.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
